adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js the iframe URL is built via simple string concatenation: `iframe.src = discourseUrl + "embed/best?embed_url=" + ...`. If `discourseUrl` is configured as a typical base like `https://forum.example.com` (no trailing `/`), the result becomes `https://forum.example.comembed/best?...`, which is an invalid/broken URL. Nothing in this diff normalizes `discourseUrl` (e.g., ensuring a trailing slash) or uses a proper URL-join, so the embed script is fragile and can silently break depending on how the host page sets `discourseUrl`.
